items.title: 2026-019: Critical Vulnerability in GitLab Community and Enterprise Editions

items.summary: CERT-EU advisory on two critical PHP flaws enabling unauthenticated RCE, fixed in 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35; PoCs are circulating and exploitation is likely underway.

items.title: 2026-017: Critical Vulnerability in Cisco Secure Email Gateway
items.summary: CERT-EU flags a critical, actively exploited flaw in the AMP feature of Cisco Secure Email Gateway allowing unauthenticated root-level command execution; patch AsyncOS or Content Scanner Tools now.

items.title: Microsoft Links Storm-0940 to ConnectWise Supply Chain Attack
items.summary: Microsoft attributes the ConnectWise supply chain attack affecting over 2,200 tenants to China-linked Storm-0940, which used an AI-enabled pentesting tool to automate the intrusion.

items.title: LiteLLM release pipeline hacked to distribute info-stealer malware
items.summary: Attackers compromised the LiteLLM project's PyPI package and Docker images to distribute an info-stealer and backdoor harvesting credentials, secrets and environment variables.

items.title: Arista Warns of Critical VeloCloud SQL Injection Zero-Day Exploited in Attacks
items.summary: Arista warns of an actively exploited SQL injection zero-day in VeloCloud Orchestrator that lets any logged-in user, even read-only, escalate to operator privileges over SD-WAN management.

items.title: Max-severity GitLab bug allows remote code execution over 12 years of releases

items.title: Hackers Exploited the PHP Vulnerabilities Days Before They Were Patched

items.title: Multiples vulnérabilités dans GitLab (22 octobre 2026)

items.title: EU member states finalize negotiating stance on Digital Omnibus
